receipt_policy: Sanitized summaries only. Raw terminal logs and raw app transcripts are not staged.

consensus: Do not allow generic runtime PASS wording.
Do not perform cleanup or connector mutation.
Do not treat skills, plugins, or MCP servers as authority grants.
Keep all GMUT gates open and mark THOS gate effect none_open_not_tested.
